verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI is a self-hosted runtime serving an API at localhost and running agents on the user's machine. However, nothing in the pack documents a no-training guarantee, a data-usage policy, a training opt-out, or a no-telemetry statement. Local execution is only adjacent to this story and does not by itself document that user data is kept out of model training, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
